MWI.note: PSRIMS is an internal tool for government bodies, not a service for the public.

facts.fact: UNDP Malawi reports that the Public Sector Reforms Information Management System was developed by the Public Sector Reforms Management Department with technical leadership from the Department of E-Government, and calls it an in-house system.
facts.system: Public Sector Reforms Information Management System (PSRIMS)

facts.fact: UNDP Malawi reports that PSRIMS, developed by the Public Sector Reforms Management Department and the Department of E-Government with MUBAS's UNIPOD, was launched in Lilongwe on 11 December 2025.
facts.system: Public Sector Reforms Information Management System (PSRIMS)
